column2: /s00Here I'll show you how to build a store./rIt's a lot, but let's take it one step at a time!/w045/kB/s00/pFirst, choose where to build your store./w045/kB/s00/pBusy spots are good, but the land costs more there./w045/kB/s00/pCheck your /c2funds/c0 and pick a spot you can afford./w045/kB/s00/pChoose a spot with the /c1D-pad/c0, then press the /c1○ button/c0./w045/s00/s10/i10/s00/m(4,250,22)(9,5,255,460,4)Once you've picked a spot, choose your /c4Store Size/c0./w045/kB/s00/pBigger stores draw more customers, but at first you can only build small ones./w045/kB/s00/pBigger stores also mean more work for your /c3clerks/c0, so think about balance./w045/kB/s00/pPick a store size level and confirm with the /c1○ button/c0./w045/kB/s00/pOnly the smallest size is available this time, so just press the /c1○ button/c0./w045/s80/kB/s00/p/m(4,420,50)(3,5,15,600,2)After the size, you get your /c4Sales Licenses/c0./w045/kB/s00/pSelling alcohol, tobacco or medicine takes a /c4Sales License/c0./w045/kB/s00/pSome /c4Sales Licenses/c0 can't be had in certain spots, so be careful./w045/kB/s00/pThis time, let's skip the /c4Sales Licenses/c0./w045/kB/s00/pUse the /c1D-pad/c0 to move the /c2cursor/c0 to /c3OK/c0./w045/s00/s12/i12/s00/w045/s98/kV/s00/pPress the /c1○ button/c0 to confirm./w045/s80/kB/s00/pNext up is /c4Edit Interior/c0./w045/kB/s00/pThis is the most important part of /c2The Conveni/c0./w045/kB/s00/pSo learn it well!/w045/kB/s00/pThe bottom left shows the /c2fixture/c0 category you've picked./w045/kB/s00/pAnd to its right are the kinds of /c2fixtures/c0./w045/kB/s00/pPick a /c2fixture/c0 with the /c1D-pad/c0 and place it with the /c1○ button/c0./w045/kB/s00/pBe sure to place at least one /c2register/c0, /c2break room/c0 and /c2shelf/c0./w045/kB/s00/pWithout those three, you can't open./w045/kB/s00/pYour main store already has some of the /c2fixtures/c0 it needs./w045/kB/s00/pAt first, use that layout as a guide./w045/kB/s00/pNow let's open the menu./rPress the /c1□ button/c0./w045/s82/kE/s00/p/m(4,225,180)(2,155,50,460,3)This is the /c4Edit Interior/c0 menu./w045/kB/s00/p/c3Load/c0 reads a layout from your /c2memory card (PS2)/c0,/w045/kB/s00/pand /c3Save/c0 stores a layout you've made./w045/kB/s00/p/c3Load/c0 also offers 3 ready-made layouts from the start,/w045/kB/s00/pso use those until you get the hang of it, then make them your own bit by bit./w045/kB/s00/pPick /c3Done Editing/c0 to move on. Press the /c1○ button/c0./w045/s80/kB/s00/p/m(4,395,15)(9,155,210,460,4)Next, let's hire some /c3clerks/c0./w045/kB/s00/pThe top box is the /c3manager/c0./rThe two below are /c3clerks/c0./w045/kB/s00/pWithout a /c3manager/c0 the store can't open, so remember that!/w045/kB/s00/pLet's hire a /c3manager/c0 right now. Move the /c2cursor/c0 to the /c3manager/c0 slot and press the /c1○ button/c0./w045/s00/s99/i30/s00/pThis shows details on your current /c3manager/c0. You haven't hired one yet, so it's empty./w045/kB/s00/pPut the /c2cursor/c0 on /c3Hire/c0 and press the /c1○ button/c0./w045/s80/kB/s00/p/m(4,395,15)(9,155,242,460,3)Here come the /c2resumes/c0./w045/kB/s00/pA /c2resume/c0 shows a name, photo, skills, past jobs and more./w045/kB/s00/p/c1D-pad/c0 up and down scrolls a /c2resume/c0. Left and right picks a person./w045/kB/s00/pNow let's hire someone. Pick with /c1D-pad/c0 left and right, then press the /c1○ button/c0./w045/s15/kB/s00/pYou've hired a /c3manager/c0!/w045/kB/s00/pHiring other /c3clerks/c0 works the same way./w045/kB/s00/pA /c3manager/c0 is all you need to open, so press /c3OK/c0 for now and move on./w045/kB/s00/pMove the /c2cursor/c0 to /c3OK/c0 with the /c1D-pad/c0 and press the /c1○ button/c0./w045/s00/s16/i16/s00/m(4,424,189)(6,5,319,490,3)/pNext, let's set your /c3clerks'/c0 pay./w045/kB/s00/pThe top item is the /c3Raise Rate/c0: how much pay goes up once a year./w045/kB/s00/pAround 1～3％ is usually fine. Let's leave the /c3Raise Rate/c0 as it is./w045/kB/s00/pPress /c1D-pad/c0 up to move the /c2cursor/c0 to /c3Pay Talks/c0./w045/s93/kP/s00/pThis decides what to do when /c3clerks/c0 ask, "Can I get a raise?"/w045/kB/s00/pPress the /c1○ button/c0 to make a choice./w045/s80/kB/s00/pYou can decide each raise yourself, or give them automatically./w045/kB/s00/pLet's go with /c3Auto-Accept/c0./rPress /c1D-pad/c0 down./w045/s97/kU/s00/pNow it's set to /c3Auto-Accept/c0. Confirm with the /c1○ button/c0./w045/s80/kB/s00/pOnce you're used to it, try handling them one by one. But if you keep saying no to raises,/w045/kB/s00/pyour /c3clerks/c0 may get fed up and quit!/w045/kB/s00/pDon't lose your precious /c3clerks/c0. Give them fair raises!/w045/kB/s00/pNow move the /c2cursor/c0 to /c3OK/c0 with the /c1D-pad/c0 and press the /c1○ button/c0 to go on./w045/s00/s17/i17/s00/m(4,419,189)(6,15,279,448,4)Next, let's set your store hours./w045/kB/s00/pIn the box below, press the /c1○ button/c0 to open or close each hour./w045/kB/s00/p/m(4,397,113)(6,15,146,448,4)The /c4Quick Hours Setup/c0 above sets the hours in one go./w045/kB/s00/pIt's set to 7 AM to 11 PM./rThat's usually fine./w045/kB/s00/pShady customers might show up late at night, after all./w045/kB/s00/pUntil your /c2Security/c0 goes up, better not open 24 hours./w045/kB/s00/pLater, when your store's /c2Security/c0 is higher, try going 24 hours!/w045/kB/s00/pNow move the /c2cursor/c0 to /c3OK/c0 with the /c1D-pad/c0 and press the /c1○ button/c0 to go on./w045/s00/s19/i19/s00/p/m(4,419,189)(6,15,279,448,4)Next, let's set the /c4Price Rate/c0 for your goods./w045/kB/s00/pA /c4Price Rate/c0 of 100％ is list price. Lower is a discount, higher is a markup./w045/kB/s00/pCheaper draws more customers, but too cheap and you won't make a profit. Careful!/w045/kB/s00/pThe top changes everything at once; the bottom changes each product. Let's leave it as is./w045/kB/s00/p/m(4,397,113)(6,15,146,448,4)Now move the /c2cursor/c0 to /c3OK/c0 with the /c1D-pad/c0 and press the /c1○ button/c0 to go on./w045/s00/s18/i18/s00/m(4,128,128)(2,52,27,420,4)And your very own store is built!/w045/kB/s00/pBuilding more stores works the same way, so remember it!/w045/kB/s00/pSee you again! Have fun with the game!/w045/kB/s00/p

/s00Now I'll explain the controls!/rRead carefully and learn them well./w045/kB/s00/p/m(4,260,-25)(9,15,205,430,4)/f05This window shows the date, the time and the weather./w045/kB/s00/pIn this game, /c2a month passes in 4 days/c0, so don't be surprised!/w045/kB/s00/p/m(4,290,21)(9,15,243,460,3)/f05This window shows how much /c2money/c0 you have./w045/kB/s00/pIf your /c2money/c0 runs out, it's /c2game over/c0!!/w045/kB/s00/p/f00/m(4,282,151)(3,46,52,420,4)/f05This is the /c2Info Window/c0./w045/kB/s00/pIt shows lots of handy info, so don't miss it!/w045/kB/s00/p/f00/m(4,150,200)(2,20,113,450,3)/f08All kinds of messages scroll by here./w045/kB/s00/pImportant ones have a /g1 mark, so be sure to read those!/w045/kB/s00/pWhen you open a menu, it shows what the buttons do./w045/kB/s00/p/f00/m(4,-15,160)(1,45,31,380,4)This is the screen for moving around the map./w045/kB/s00/pYou can move the /c2cursor/c0 with the /c1D-pad/c0./w045/kB/s00/pThe /c2Info Window/c0 on the right shows info on whatever the /c2cursor/c0 is on./w045/kB/s00/pLet's try moving it now./rPut the /c2cursor/c0 on your /c2main store/c0./w045/kB/s00/p/m(4,-64,220)(4,120,290,360,3)Your /c2main store/c0 is /c2under its circle mark/c0./w045/kB/s00/pUse the /c1D-pad/c0 to put the /c2cursor/c0 on your /c2main store/c0./w045/s00/s09/i00/s00/pYou found your /c2main store/c0!/w045/kB/s00/pNext, let's look for /c2Store #2/c0. But it's not on the screen./w045/kB/s00/pThen the full map makes it easy to find./w045/kB/s00/pPress in the /c1left stick/c0 or the /c1right stick/c0./w045/s92/kT/s00/p/m(4,300,60)(9,165,289,306,4)Now you can see the whole map!/w045/kB/s00/pYou can also check your progress and goals here./w045/kB/s00/pPress in either stick again to go back to the map./w045/s92/kT/s00/p/m(4,-35,64)(7,25,289,450,4)Hmm, /c2Store #2/c0 is pretty far from your /c2main store/c0. Let's try a store search./w045/kB/s00/pPress the /c1R1 button/c0 to jump through your stores one by one./w045/kB/s00/pGo ahead, press the /c1R1 button/c0./w045/s84/kF/s00/p/s00/i01/s00You jumped to /c2Store #2/c0, right?/rIf you lose track of a store, give it a press./w045/kB/s00/pNow let's look inside a store./w045/kB/s00/pThe /c1× button/c0 takes you to the store list./rPress the /c1× button/c0./w045/s81/kC/s00/p/f00/m(4,291,182)(6,10,238,330,4)Here you can see up to four stores at once./w045/kB/s00/pThe left shows each store from above. The right shows its sales and rating./w045/kB/s00/pUnder each store, messages scroll by. They tell you what happened inside./w045/kB/s00/pKeep an eye on those too./w045/kB/s00/pMove the /c2cursor/c0 to pick a store. Press the /c1○ button/c0 to zoom in on it./w045/kB/s00/pThe /c2cursor/c0 is on /c2Store #2/c0 now. Press the /c1○ button/c0./w045/s80/kB/s00/p/m(4,284,129)(2,190,10,415,4)On this screen you can look all around the store./w045/kB/s00/pThe /c1left stick/c0 turns the store; the /c1right stick/c0 moves the view./w045/s08/rPress /c1○/c0 when done./w045/kB/s00/pNow try the /c1R1 button/c0 and /c1R2 button/c0./w045/s07/rPress /c1○/c0 when done./w045/kB/s00/pLike that, you can zoom the view in and out./w045/kB/s00/pPress in the /c1left stick/c0 or /c1right stick/c0 to see the store from straight above./w045/kB/s00/pPress in the /c1left stick/c0 or the /c1right stick/c0./w045/s92/kT/s00/pPress it in again to go back. Press in the /c1left stick/c0 or /c1right stick/c0./w045/s92/kT/s00/pSee? You can look at the store from any angle. View it however you like!♪/w045/kB/s00/pAlso, press the /c1○ button/c0 on this screen to check things in the store./w045/s80/kB/s00/p/m(4,276,108)(2,210,5,405,4)Time stops in this /c2Free Cursor Mode/c0, so take your time looking around./w045/kB/s00/p/f01The /c2Info Window/c0 shows the shelf, clerk or customer under the /c2cursor/c0./w045/kB/s00/pPress the /c1○ button/c0 here to open a menu./w045/s80/kB/s00/pOn a shelf, you can see product details or swap the products./w045/kB/s00/pThe same way, put the /c2cursor/c0 on a customer to kick them out./w045/kB/s00/pPut it on a tired clerk to give them a break./w045/kB/s00/pIf you spot a customer with bad manners, kick them out!/w045/kB/s00/pPress the /c1× button/c0 to close the menu./w045/s81/kC/s00/p/f01/m(4,128,128)(2,52,27,420,4)And that's it for the controls./w045/kB/s00/pPress the /c1START button/c0 to see the controls again whenever you forget./w045/kB/s00/pAnd when the /g2 mark shows at the top right, press the /c1△ button/c0 and we'll come!♪/w045/kB/s00/pIf running things gets tough, or a menu has you stumped, just call us!♪/w045/kB/s00/pNow take your time and enjoy the game!/rSee you again!!/w045/kB/s00/p
